author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Lewis Hamilton and Oliver Bearman both crashed during final practice for Formula One’s Spanish Grand Prix at Madrid’s new Madring circuit, interrupting the last track session before Saturday qualifying. Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli finished fastest, with Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc next on the timing sheet.

Hamilton locked his Ferrari at the final corner and hit the barriers with a little more than half an hour remaining. He initially tried to drive the damaged car toward the pits with its front wing trapped underneath and a punctured right-front tire, then stopped after repeated instructions from the team. The session was red-flagged while crews repaired the barrier. Bearman later brought another stoppage when he crashed his Haas near the end.

The incidents added uncertainty before qualifying on a layout where close walls and higher speeds leave little margin for error. Drivers have also said overtaking may be difficult, increasing the importance of grid position for Sunday’s race. Antonelli’s pace gave Mercedes a strong final-practice marker, but the disrupted session limited representative running for several teams as they prepared their qualifying setups.
dek: The two crashes interrupted the final session at the new Madring circuit, where Kimi Antonelli set the fastest practice time.
headline: Hamilton and Bearman crash as Antonelli leads Spanish GP practice
